source_refs.note: Exercise 8.4, Question 4 (book p. 253); answer key p. 307 (PDF 309).

blocks.prompt: 4. In a certain cryptographic system, the decoding speed \(v\) (in units per second) is related to the security delay function \(d(v) = \frac{v^{2}}{20 + v}\), where \(d(v)\) represents the decoding delay in milliseconds. For secure transmission, the system requires a decoding delay of 50 milliseconds. Use Newton-Raphson Method with initial guess \(v_0 = 35\) to determine the decoding speed \(v\) that satisfies \(d(v) = 50\), correct to three decimal places.
blocks.explanation:
Humein woh speed v chahiye jis par delay d(v) theek 50 ho. Is ko root ke sawal mein badalne ke liye f(v) = d(v) - 50 = 0 likhte hain.
Diya kya hai? Formula d(v) aur shuruati guess v_0 = 35. Find kya karna hai? v, teen decimal places tak.
Rule kaunsa? Newton-Raphson, jis ke liye derivative quotient rule se nikalega.
Plan: f aur f' banana, 5 decimal places ke saath iterations chalana, aur tab rukna jab do lagataar values 0.0005 se kam farq rakhein.
Aakhir mein fraction hata kar exact jawab se tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(d(v) = \frac{v^{2}}{20 + v}\), chahiye \(d(v) = 50\), aur \(v_0 = 35\).
Maloom karna: \(v\), teen decimal places tak.
Tareeqa: Newton-Raphson, \(v_{n+1} = v_n - f(v_n)/f'(v_n)\), jaisa sawal ne kaha.

f(v) = 0 banaiye
\[f(v) = \dfrac{v^{2}}{20 + v} - 50\]
Kyun: f ka root wahi speed hai jis par delay bilkul 50 ms hai. Newton-Raphson ko hamesha '= 0' wali shakal chahiye.

Derivative (quotient rule)
\[f'(v) = \dfrac{(20 + v)(2v) - v^{2}(1)}{(20 + v)^{2}}\]
\[= \dfrac{v^{2} + 40v}{(20 + v)^{2}} = \dfrac{v(v + 40)}{(v + 20)^{2}}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{u}{w}\) ka derivative \(\frac{wu' - uw'}{w^{2}}\) hota hai; yahan \(u = v^{2}\), \(w = 20 + v\). Constant 50 ka derivative zero. \(v > 0\) ke liye \(f'(v) > 0\), yani \(f'(v) \ne 0\) aur method lag sakta hai.
Dhyan dein: numerator mein ulta order (uw' - wu') likhna aam ghalti hai; is se sign hi badal jata hai.

Iteration 1: v_0 = 35
\[f(35) = \dfrac{1225}{55} - 50 = -27.72727\]
\[f'(35) = \dfrac{35(75)}{55^{2}} = \dfrac{2625}{3025}\]
\[= 0.86777\]
\[v_1 = 35 + \dfrac{27.72727}{0.86777} = 66.95238\]
Kyun: f(35) negative hai, yani 35 par delay 50 se kam hai, is liye v ko barhna chahiye. Slope chhota (0.87) hai, is liye qadam bara laga.

Iteration 2: v_1 = 66.95238
\[f(v_1) = \dfrac{4482.62119}{86.95238} - 50\]
\[= 1.55260\]
\[f'(v_1) = 0.94709\]
\[v_2 = 66.95238 - \dfrac{1.55260}{0.94709}\]
\[= 65.31305\]
Kyun: pehla qadam root se aage nikal gaya tha (ab f positive hai), is liye yeh qadam wapas aaya. Newton-Raphson mein aisa hona aam baat hai.

Tasdeeq
\[d(65.311) = \dfrac{65.311^{2}}{85.311} \approx 50.000\]
Exact: \(v^{2} = 50(20 + v)\), yani \(v^{2} - 50v - 1000 = 0\), to \(v = 25 + \sqrt{1625} = 65.31129\). Doosra root \(-15.31\) rad, kyun ke speed negative nahin hoti.
Kyun: fraction hata kar quadratic banti hai jis ka exact root iterations se bilkul milta hai.
